reviews.comment: Best prof ever. Gave extra time on hw assignments (total of 4) when people would ask in the GroupMe. Only midterm and final exams that are just like the mock. Little prior coding experience goes a long way, but not needed. Helps answer questions and debug code during class. Just show up, listen, and do the code for yourself - you'll make an A.

Dr. Dasgupta is a real gem. He's willing to go out of his way for students, and really wanted us all to succeed. I've never met a professor that truly cares about our education more than Dr. Dasgupta. He's funny, makes class enjoyable, provides many opportunities for practice, and is extremely accessible outside of class. Take him, you won't regret

Prof Dasgupta was awesome. He makes the material super straight forward and actually wants you to learn the material. He is very easy to get in touch with and you can easily make an A. He is probably the best prof I have ever had at TAMU.

Cares that you pass and take something from the class rather than focusing on just trying to get a good grade. Always willing to work with you, has a fantastic sense of humor. Getting to take a class with this professor is a treat.

Dr Dasgupta is honestly great. He really wants you to pass as long as you communicate it with him he is always willing to help. Plenty of office hours and hes a good lecturer and funny! Loved his class would definitely take him again
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Loved this class! I never went! I have a 100% in the class and use his powerpoints! They are easy to follow! This class has easy homeworks with lots of chances. Tests are open notes! He really wants you to do well in this class! Would take again!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Dasgupta makes this content extremely straightforward to understand. Look at the material posted on Canvas (especially all the examples) and the homeworks/exams follow directly. He is also very understanding
Take this class, just trust me.

Dr. Sutanoy Dasgupta is actually one of the best profs I have had at A&M. This is the first review I am doing on Rate my Professor, since he is just that good. Not only does he explain everything very clearly and gives you all the resources to succeed, he actually cares about his students and doesn't make the class too hard. Take him if you can.
Super nice guy. Tests were open note during COVID. You can get an A just by going to class and paying attention. I never went and didn't study so I got a B.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Prof Dasgupta was an awesome teacher. He wants his students to succeed very much so we get a lot of practice material, recorded lectures, extra credit, etc. Super nice guy, responds to emails fast. He will re-explain anything in lecture if you are confused.

Dr. Sutanoy is a good choice! He explains the concepts very well and not too fast if you are not familiar with stats. He gives little hw/quizzes, answers questions on GroupMe, and truly cares for his students. His exams are similar to the practice tests he posts. Attendance is not mandatory. He wants students to succeed!
